title: Chapter 319 - 319 Celebration; I'M Straight!
content:
Chapter 319 - 319 Celebration; I'M Straight!

Chapter 319 - 319 Celebration; I'm Straight!

319 Celebration; I’m Straight!

Seeing this…

Lin Fan only said, “Ningjing, did you see that? Don’t panic when driving, or you’ll crash.”

“Alright.” Su Ningjing nodded seriously.

Then, the two of them stepped on the accelerator and sped into the distance.

The man was left alone in the same spot, choking on the exhaust and coughing non-stop.

Not long after Lin Fan and Su Ningjing arrived at Washington Palace, the clothes and shoes that they had bought earlier were all sent over.

Lin Fan saw that the sky was gradually darkening. He did not stay in Washington Palace for long and returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa alone.

He sat on the soft sofa, took out his phone, and focused on the red packet.

“105 red packets? Let’s see what I can get.”

Obviously, these were the red packets he had received from buying clothes, shoes, and some expenses for the past few days.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received eight yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 8,888 yuan.]

…

From the 102 red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 98,103 yuan and a one yuan critical hit card.

One had to know that a one yuan critical hit card could be used to obtain 100 million yuan immediately after spending one yuan.

In other words…

Lin Fan spent the past two days buying clothes, eating, flying, and so on. Not only did he not spend any money, but he even earned 100 million yuan.

Not bad.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

It was his sister, Lin Xiaoyao.

“Brother, did you invent that super battery?” Lin Xiaoyao’s anxious voice came from the phone.

Lin Fan thought to himself, ‘So the news has already reached Lil Yao.’

“Yes,” he replied.

“Then… Dahua Phone Group signed a 1.5 billion contract with you?” Lin Xiaoyao asked again.

“That’s right,” Lin Fan said.

“F*ck!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly,

…

Meanwhile, at Jiangbei University.

Zhao Ni walked briskly back to the dormitory.

When she saw Xia Bing and Xia Xue sitting at the table and reading seriously, she could not help but smile and greet them. “It’s so late. Why are you still studying?”

As she spoke, she casually glanced at Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s book.

Soon, Zhao Ni’s face revealed a hint of doubt.

“4Li-4e=4Li+? Is this a chemical reaction equation? Why are you guys reading a chemistry book?” Zhao Ni asked.

One had to know…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue were geniuses in the computer science department. They even won the Higher Education Cup last year.

Although many people said that a large part of the reason why they were able to win the Higher Education Cup was because of Lin Fan, this did not deny their superb computer skills.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue stuttered, “We’re j-just l-l-looking.”

Zhao Ni shrugged her shoulders and said, “Alright, this is probably the difference between the top students and us losers.”

Then, she walked toward the bathroom.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue looked down at the title on the cover of the Science journal… Principles and Applications of Super Batteries.

Then, the two of them started to read it more attentively.

…

Last night, Lin Fan had reminded Su Ningjing not to come over to prepare breakfast.

Firstly, Lin Fan felt that it was too tiring for her to rush over so early in the morning.

Secondly, Lin Fan wanted to go to school today

The leaders of Jiangbei University had already said that they would give him the greatest freedom.

However, no matter what, he was still a student. It was not good for him to not go to school for a long time.

Hence, Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class and ate breakfast at a high-end restaurant nearby. When he walked out of the restaurant, he bought a bottle of mineral water from a small supermarket nearby.

[Ding! You spent one yuan. Do you want to use the one yuan critical hit card?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! You’ve successfully used it. Congratulations on obtaining 100 million yuan.]

Instantly, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 100,000,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class toward Jiangbei University.

He had not been to school for a few days, but there was not much change.

However, there was another banner in front of the gate congratulating him on his invention of the super battery.

When Lin Fan parked his car and walked toward the classroom, a deep voice suddenly sounded behind him.

“Lin Fan, good morning!”

Lin Fan slowly turned around and said, “Good morning, Counselor Sun.”

Sun Yaodong quickened his pace and hugged Lin Fan’s arm, smiling, “Why are you being so polite to me?”

Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

Polite?

‘Did you not greet me first?

‘I was just responding politely.’

Sun Yaodong praised, “Not bad, Lin Fan. You’re really not bad!

“I told you that your ability was outstanding and that you’d definitely bring glory to our class. Unexpectedly, you even invented the super battery!”

Lin Fan’s lips twitched once more.

He had outstanding ability and brought glory to the class…

‘Counselor Sun, do you really only know how to praise people with these same words?’

“You invented the super battery and signed such a big contract. Do you want to celebrate?”

Celebrate?

Lin Fan really had not thought about it before.

In his eyes, 1.5 billion was nothing.

After all, his daily income was close to 20 million. After using the one yuan critical hit card today, he had an additional 100 million.

He also often obtained office buildings worth billions and company shares worth tens of billions.

If he had to celebrate every time, he would probably be constantly celebrating.

However, no one else knew about this.

Everyone knew about the contract worth 1.5 billion, though.

Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, “We do have to celebrate. I don’t think we have any classes this afternoon. After the morning class ends, I’ll celebrate with the students. Counselor Sun, are you joining?”

“Is it appropriate for me to join?” Sun Yaodong asked hesitantly.”

Lin Fan opened his mouth and was about to say that it was fine if he did not want to go.

However, Sun Yaodong immediately smiled and said, “Okay!” I’ll come to the class after I arrange my work for the afternoon!”

Then, he patted Lin Fan’s shoulder and walked into the office with his head held high.

Lin Fan could not help but reveal a strange look.

Why did it feel like… the counselor seemed to have specially come over to freeload?

Lin Fan shook his head and threw this small matter to the back of his mind. He went straight to class.

“Brother Lin Fan, you’re finally here!” Song Yi said excitedly. “We thought that after you took 1.5 billion, you would drop out of school and go home to enjoy your life!”

When the surrounding students heard the figure of 1.5 billion, they all cast envious gazes.

Lin Fan smiled. “I originally wanted to drop out of school and go home to enjoy my life. But when I thought about how all of you cute classmates were still in school, I came back.”

“Brother Lin Fan…”

Song Yi called out softly. He was so touched that he opened his arms as if he wanted to give Lin Fan a bear hug.

Lin Fan immediately said, “Stop! I’m straight!”
